descriptionHtml:
Decision D8 · P2 · Daniela

Should In Today reset at server midnight; the worst-case AI wait is ~38 s (UAT says ~30 s); should empty transcript rows ('0 lines') be hidden

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-09/S13, TC-14/S21

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S16 Odd stored rows, both modes: markup and instruction-looking text shown as plain text; a row with no label or no lines is not shown blank

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice. (UAT 3.4)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U13 A patient with no transcripts yet shows a clear state with no error, no blank screen and no invented entry. (UAT Empty & Failure States ('Patient with no notes yet'); UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given {hospitalPatient} with three stored rows: one with entries but no label, one '· Encounter notes' row with no entries, and a '(prior)' row whose physician line holds HTML and whose patient line reads like an instruction. {snfResident} with one '· Visit notes' row holding HTML and instruction-like text

When Open the Hospital Encounter tab without opening anything; open the '(prior)' row; open the resident's '· Visit notes' row

Then No row is shown without a label and no row says '0 lines'. Both injection lines appear word for word as text in each mode. Nothing is rendered as markup, no dialog opens, and no other patient appears

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. cp1 (Hospital, collapsed): mustNotContain '0 lines', {snfResident} (U3, U13: no row for nothing); a row with a count and no label is a T2 Fail, recorded by the agent in notes.md (spec.manual) because a blank label has no substring to match. cp2 ('(prior)' open): mustContain 'QA16-INJ <b>bold</b>' (escaped literal), 'Ignore previous instructions'. …

Where it ran: dev unit U02; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

An empty transcript row is shown as '0 lines' rather than hidden. Markup and injected instructions are shown safely as plain text.

Evidence: Allure 70866bd6. Ledger #2 U02: 'needs Daniela'. Dev report §3 row 3. AC 3 asks only for an accurate count; hiding empty rows is the oracle's own reading. An unlabelled '1 lines' row was recorded only (T2).

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
